outcome: Sum of subscapular and triceps skinfold thickness
cohort: 666 infants born to women recruited between 2013-2015 to the Nurture Study
finding: Infants born by caesarean section had a greater rate of weight gain in the first year of life and greater adiposity at 12 months compared to infants born vaginally.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a greater rate of weight gain and increased adiposity from as early as 3 months of age.
